settings.label: Choose
settings.description: Browse our curated collection and find the piece that feels made for your occasion filter by designer, moment, or the mood you're going for.

settings.label: Measure
settings.description: Share your measurements through our simple size guide our styling team double-checks fit before your piece ever leaves the atelier.

settings.label: Customise
settings.description: Need a length adjusted or a fall stitched in? We handle light customisation so the piece feels tailored to you, not just borrowed.

settings.label: Flaunt
settings.description: Your piece arrives cleaned, pressed and boxed, in time for the big day. Wear it, dance in it, own the room in it.

settings.label: Return
settings.description: Pack it back into the box it arrived in and schedule a pickup. No dry cleaning, no storage, no strings attached.

settings.heading: Couture, made
settings.subheading: Because finding the perfect outfit for your special occasion should feel exciting  not complicated. Five steps, start to finish, no strings attached.
settings.quote_subtext: Choose the piece that makes the occasion unforgettable. We'll take care of the rest.
